tooltip: When you Attack enemy champions, fire 5 missiles that each deal {DamagePerBolt} physical damage, increased up to 50% with distance traveled. Each cardinal direction has a 8 second Cooldown.  Each bolt can Critically Strike and applies On-Hits at 20% effectiveness.  Damage Dealt: {f2}

name: DropBear
summary: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.
tooltip: On Death, summon Tibbers, dealing {AOEDamage} Magic Damage to all enemies around you, Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Tibbers then chases your Killer.  Tibbers also has all of your Augments.

name: Shark Bait
summary: A few seconds after death, a shark chomps all nearby enemies. You can move after death to aim the shark attack.
tooltip: On death, become Shark Bait. You can take no actions other than moving, which slows nearby enemies by 40%. After a few seconds, a Shark emerges, knocking up all nearby Enemies and biting them for {BaseDamageToApply} + {MissingHealthPercentDamage} Missing Health Magic Damage.  Times the Shark consumed an Enemy Champion: {f2.0}

name: Shark Tempest
summary: Sharks circle your Snowball, slowing and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!
tooltip: Sharks circle your Snowball, slowing and dealing {BaseDamageTotal} magic damage to enemies they pass through. If your Snowball hits a Champion, the Sharks attach to them and create a Shark Tempest, which deals {AttachedDamagePerSecond} magic damage per second and Slows nearby enemies by 40% for 3 seconds.

name: Hide on Bush
summary: After entering Brush, deal 20% more damage for 2 seconds. Remain in the Brush to refresh the effect.
tooltip: Entering Brush grants Brush Power for 2 seconds. While Brush Power is active, you deal 20% more damage.  Damage done: {f1}  Staying in Brush refreshes Brush Power.

name: Nature is Healing
summary: Entering Brush regenerates a large amount of Health.
tooltip: Entering Brush restores {FlatHeal} + {MissingHealthHeal} Missing Health, 20 second cooldown per brush.  Total Healing: {f1.0}

name: Tripleshot
summary: Your {{SpellName}} targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.
tooltip: {{Kiwi_SpellVolley_Summary}}  Additional Targets Hit: {f1} Units take less damage from the same spell.

name: Multishot
summary: QUEST: Hit enemy Champions with {{SpellName}} {QuestRequirement} times.  REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.
tooltip: QUEST: Hit enemy Champions with {{SpellName}} {QuestRequirement} times.  REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.

name: Terror
summary: Whenever you cast {{SpellName}}, Fear enemies around you.
tooltip: Whenever you cast {{SpellName}}, Fear enemies around you for 1.75 seconds.

name: Dimension Shift
summary: Gain the When the Darkness Comes Summoner Spell. Create a zone that transports everyone inside of it to another dimension.
tooltip: Gain the Summoner Spell When the Darkness Comes.  When the Darkness Comes: Launch a brilliant light at a position. When it lands, every living unit within the area will be sent to a different Realm for 8 seconds.  While you are in this Realm, you gain: %i:scaleHealth% {HealthIncrease} Health %i:scaleAP% {APIncrease} Ability Power %i:scaleAD% {ADIncrease} Attack Damage %i:scaleSize% {SelfScaleIncrease} Size  All units can move and act freely in that Realm but cannot target objectives such as Turrets or Inhibitors.  "Follow your Light..." — A Lost Soul

name: Quickstep
summary: When you use {{SpellName}}, dash towards your cursor.
tooltip: {{Kiwi_Augment_Vanguard_Desc}}

name: Spell Split
summary: Your {{SpellName}} missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when Recast.
tooltip: {{Kiwi_Missile_Split_Summary}}   Additional target hit: {f1} Enemies take less damage if hit by the same spell.

name: Siphon
summary: Damaging enemy champions with {{SpellName}} heals you.
tooltip: Heal for 30% of the damage dealt to enemy champions by {{SpellName}}.

name: Stay Resolute
summary: When {{Spellname}} damages enemy champions, gain {ARMR_Inc} Armor and Magic Resistance.
tooltip: Damaging enemy champions with {{SpellName}} grants you {ARMR_Inc} Armor or Magic Resistance based on their %i:miniAdaptiveForce% Damage Type.   Bonus Armor: {f1} Bonus Magic Resistance: {f2}   If this is not your first augment, gain 20 Armor and Magic Resistance.

name: Chain Reaction
summary: If a target Knocked Back by {{SpellName}} hits another champion, they are Knocked Up and dealt damage. When colliding with terrain, the Knock Up duration is extended and they are dealt bonus damage.
tooltip: If a champion you Knock Back with {{SpellName}} hits another champion, they are Knocked Up for 0.5 seconds and are dealt {EnemyHitDamage} magic damage. If enemy champions collide with terrain, they are Knocked Up for 0.75 seconds and are dealt {WallCollisionDamage} magic damage.  Enemies Knocked Up: {f1} Walls Hit: {f2}  Knock Up Duration and Height scale with your spell's cooldown. Damage is increased to {Ult_DamageAmp} for Ultimate Abilities.

name: Ravenous Bind
summary: Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champions with {{SpellName}} deals extra damage and heals you.
tooltip: Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champions with {{SpellName}} deals an additional {Damage} magic damage and heals {f3} Health.  Total Damage: {f2} Minimum healing: {Heal} Total Healing: {f1}  Healing increases up to 50% based on spell cooldown.

name: Our Healing
summary: Whenever someone heals around you, you heal 15% of their own healing. Doubled from Enemy healing.
tooltip: {{Kiwi_Augment_Equilibrium_Summary}}

name: Tooth Fairy
summary: Bursting enemies drops Teeth. Picking up Teeth grants you permanent Lethality and Magic Penetration.
tooltip: When you deal more than {BurstRequirement} of an enemy champion's Health in less than 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth.  Your {f1} Teeth collection currently gives you {LethalityPerTooth} Lethality and {MPenPerTooth} Magic Penetration.   4 seconds cooldown per target

name: Titan's Resolve
summary: Gain stacks when taking or dealing damage. For every 10 stacks, gain Adaptive Force, Armor, Magic Resist, Size, and Tenacity.
tooltip: Dealing and receiving champion damage grants you 1 stack of Juggernauting for 6 seconds. For every 10 stacks of Juggernauting you gain {Calc_AF} Adaptive Force, {Calc_Defenses} Armor, {Calc_Defenses} Magic Resist, {Calc_Size} Size, and {Calc_Tenacity} Tenacity.  Stacks fall off faster the more you have. Maximum Juggernauting Level: {f1.0}

name: Snowday
summary: Gain 100 Ability Haste on your Snowball. It deals additional magic damage when hitting an enemy. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
tooltip: Snowball gains 100 Ability Haste and deals 100% increased damage.

name: Echo Cast
summary: Casting your {{SpellName}} sends a clone toward your mouse position and recasts it.
tooltip: Casting your {{SpellName}} sends a clone of the ability toward your mouse position and recasts it after 0.25 seconds.

name: Yowch, My Coins!
summary: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth 15 gold.
tooltip: On takedown, enemy champions drop {Calc_Max_Coins_To_Drop} coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth 15 gold.  Out of {f5} total Coins dropped from {f6} voluntary donors, your team has gained {f3} Gold, with {f4} Gold picked by yourself.

name: Endless Decimation
summary: While in combat, Autocast a circular axe that deals physical damage. Enemies on the outer edge take additional damage and heal you.
tooltip: Autocast a circular axe swing that deals physical damage every 8 seconds in combat. Enemies along the outer edge take increased damage ({FullDamage}) and heal you 18% of your Missing Health. Each enemy hit along the outer edge reduces this ability's cooldown by 10% down to a minimum of 3 seconds.

name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
summary: When moving towards allies with low Health, gain Movement Speed. Your Healing and Shielding are greater based on how low your target's Health is.
tooltip: Gain up to {Calc_Move_Speed_Max} Move Speed toward nearby allies based on their missing Health. Your healing and shielding are also increased up to {Calc_HS_Amp_Max} based on the target's missing Health.  Bonus Healing: {f1.0} Bonus Shielding: {f2.0}

name: Archmage
summary: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by 30% of the original spell's Cooldown.
tooltip: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by 30% of the original spell's Cooldown.

name: Stackosaurus Rex
summary: When you gain permanent Stacks of an Ability, gain 100% more!
tooltip: When you gain permanent Stacks of an Ability, gain 100% more!

name: Lil' Extra Help
summary: Gain {RangeIncrease} Attack Range and {ExtraAttackSpeed} Attack Speed during your {{SpellName}} duration.
tooltip: Gain {RangeIncrease} Attack Range and {ExtraAttackSpeed} Attack Speed during your {{SpellName}} duration.

name: Void Dash
summary: Dashing with {{Spellname}} spawns a Void Zone that Slows enemy champions and deals magic damage.
tooltip: {{SpellName}} spawns a Void Zone at the targeted destination. It Slows enemy champions for 35% for 1 seconds, and deals {TotalDamage} magic damage.   Champions Slowed: {f1}

name: Rite of Ascension
summary: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants movement speed and resets basic ability cooldowns.
tooltip: Champion takedowns within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds. Attacking an Essence consumes it.  Consuming an Essence blinks you to its location, makes you Untargetable and Unstoppable, grants {Calc_Move_Speed} Move Speed decaying over 2 seconds, heals you {Calc_Heal_Min} to {Calc_Heal_Max} based on your Missing Health, and resets your basic Ability cooldowns.   Healing: {f1.0} Cooldown Time Refunded: {f3.0}  Today, you will see the power of Ascension! — Azir, the Emperor of the Sands

name: From Downtown
summary: QUEST: Snipe {QuestRequirement} enemy champions with abilities  REWARD: Send a meteor at Sniped enemy champions, dealing Magic damage in an area around them
tooltip: {{Augment_BangBang_Tooltip{f3}}}  Bang! Bang! Oh, what a shot!

name: Spirit Bomb
summary: Healing and Shielding allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto lowest Health ally to heal and shield them and nearby allies.
tooltip: Healing and Shielding builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the Spirit Bomb at your lowest Health ally. After reaching the target, it heals nearby allies for {Calc_Heal} of their missing Health and grants them a {Calc_Shield} current Health shield for 2 seconds.  Spirit Bombs Tossed: {f1.0} Healing: {f2.0} Shielding: {f3.0}

name: Hellbent
summary: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you revive empowered upon death.
tooltip: Striking enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants you a stack of Revivemaxxing for 6 seconds (max: 10). At max stacks become Hellbent.  Hellbent: Upon dying, revive over the course of 4 seconds at {Calc_Revive_Max_Health} max Health. Afterwards, you gain {Calc_AdaptiveForce} Adaptive Force, {Calc_MoveSpeed} Move Speed towards enemy champions, and {Calc_Omnivamp} Omnivamp for 15 seconds.  This has a 90 second cooldown.

name: En Passant
summary: Periodically identify Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals max Health true damage, restores Health, and grants Movement Speed. These effects can stack.
tooltip: Periodically identify Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting Vitals with Attacks or Abilities deals an additional 6% + 1.5% per stack max Health true damage, restores {VitalHeal} + 5% Missing Health, and grants {MovementSpeed} + 5% per stack Bonus Movement Speed, decaying over 2 seconds.  Most Vitals hit in a row: {f1}

name: Snowblast
summary: Recasting Snowball deals increased damage, Knocks Up the target, and Knocks Back nearby enemies.
tooltip: Your Snowball gains 100 Ability Haste. The ability's recast deals {DamageAmp} increased damage, Knocks Up the target, and knocks back nearby enemies.  Units knocked back: {f1}

name: Pressure Cooker
summary: Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health.  QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions.  REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.
tooltip: {{Kiwi_PressureCooker_Tooltip{f4}}}

name: Snap Back
summary: Recast {{SpellName}} to explode and return to your original position.
tooltip: Recast {{SpellName}} to explode for {SnapDamage} magic damage and return to your original position.

name: Combusting Interest
summary: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate gold.
tooltip: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate {GoldPerProc} + 0.75% of damage dealt as Gold.  Gold Generated: {f1}

name: Pursuit of Power
summary: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with {{SpellName}} {QuestRequirement} times.  REWARD: Permanently increase {{SpellName}} damage.
tooltip: {{Augment_SpecializedEmpowerment_Tooltip{f6}}}

name: Squishy Slappy Grab
summary: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.
tooltip: Occasionally send out Squishy Slappy Hands that latch on to all nearby enemy champions for 4 seconds. While you're latched onto enemies, your next attack will pull them to you, deal {Calc_Damage} magic damage, and stun them for 0.25 seconds. You gain {Calc_Shield} shield for 2.5 seconds per pulled enemy.  This has a 30 second cooldown.  Enemies Yoinked: {f1.0} Damage Dealt: {f2.0} Shield Gained: {f3.0}

name: BONK!
summary: Attacks and Abilities empowered by {{SpellName}} deal additional damage to the target and nearby enemies.
tooltip: Attacks and Abilities empowered by {{SpellName}} deal an additional 30% damage to the target and nearby enemies.  Additional Champions Bonked: {f1}

name: Overloaded
summary: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of {{SpellName}}.
tooltip: {{Augment_Overloaded_Summary}}  Resets: {f1.0} Useful Resets: {f2.0} Reset Efficacy: {f3.0}%  "They come for the scroll... Stick to the plan... EQEQEQ..." — The Blue One

name: It's Go Time
summary: Activating {{SpellName}} grants you Movement Speed for its duration.
tooltip: Activating {{SpellName}} grants you {Calc_Move_Speed} Movement Speed for its duration.

name: Reload
summary: Basic Attacks {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} during {{SpellName}} reduce its cooldown.
tooltip: Basic Attacks {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} during {{SpellName}} reduce its cooldown by {f2} seconds.  Seconds Saved: {f1}

name: Don't Change the Channel
summary: Gain a Shield for every second you spend Channeling.
tooltip: While Channeling gain {Calc_Shield} Shield every second. It decays when you are not Channeling.  Total Shield: {f1.0}

name: Trusty Weapon
summary: Striking enemy champions with {{SpellName}} forges a bond of Friendship.  {{SpellName}} gains temporarily increased damage based on your level of Friendship.
tooltip: When you strike an enemy champion with {{SpellName}}, forge a bond of Friendship that grants it {Calc_Damage_Amp} increased damage for 6 seconds. This effect can stack.  Bonus Damage: {f1.0} Maximum Friendship Level: {f2.0}  "It's—it's not like I like you or anything!!" — {{SpellNameOnly}}

name: Warlock Juicebox
summary: Gain {Calc_Vamp} Omnivamp.
tooltip: Gain {Calc_Vamp} Omnivamp.

name: Pin Cushion
summary: Attacks during {{SpellName}} gouge your target with Nails. Nails accumulate damage, execute, and grant Movement Speed upon expiration.
tooltip: Attacks during {{SpellName}} gouge your target with Nails.  Nails explode once {{SpellName}} expires, dealing {DamagePerStack} Physical Damage and granting 10 Move Speed per stack for 3 seconds. Nails will explode early and execute if the accumulated damage would kill the enemy champion.  Most Nails Detonated: {f1}

name: Pat On The Back
summary: Allies encourage you when you walk past, granting you a Shield and Movement Speed.
tooltip: Allies encourage you when you walk past them, granting you {Calc_Shield} Shield and {Calc_MS} Movement Speed for 3 seconds. This effect can stack.  Each ally has a {Calc_Per_Target_Cooldown} cooldown before they can pat you on the back again.  Encouragements Received: {f1.0}

name: Porcupine
summary: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles that fly out of you, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
tooltip: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles. At critical mass, the needles burst, dealing {Calc_Damage} physical damage and Slowing  nearby enemies by {Calc_Slow} for 2 seconds.  Bursts: {f1.0} Damage: {f2.0}

name: Bolstered
summary: Shields granted from {{SpellName}} are stronger and scaling with target's missing Health.
tooltip: Shields granted from {{SpellName}} are up to 60% stronger, scaling with target's missing Health.  Bonus Shield: {f1} Most effective at 30% max health.

name: Adaptive Ward
summary: Striking an enemy champion with {{SpellName}} grants you {Calc_Resists} Armor or Magic Resist based on their damage type for 6 seconds. This effect can stack.
tooltip: Striking an enemy champion with {{SpellName}} grants you {Calc_Resists} Armor or Magic Resist based on their damage type for 6 seconds. This effect can stack.  Maximum Ward Level: {f2.0}

name: Double Strike
summary: {{SpellName}} applies {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects an additional time.
tooltip: {{SpellName}} applies {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }} effects an additional time.

name: Clown College
summary: Gain Deceive Summoner Spell. Gain Backstab Passive.  When you die, deal a large amount of true damage and Fear nearby enemies.
tooltip: Backstab: You deal {BasicAttackDamage} bonus physical damage when striking from behind.  Deceive: You teleport and become Invisible for 3 seconds. Your next Attack while Invisible deals an additional {TotalDamage} physical damage. If striking from behind, this Attack critically strikes for {QCritDamageMod} damage.  Hallucinate: Death: On death, deal 25% maximum Health true damage and fear for 1s around you.
